answer: The marble schedule is applied in velvet and sable shows each instalment. An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and as a result 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1108 identities would post 700 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
